verdict.rationale: Pilot's evidence pack covers bookkeeping service scope, CFO advisory, R&D credits, and general 'custom workflows/reporting' claims, but no documentation mentions chart-of-accounts customization, account types, sub-accounts, or class/tag dimensions. Since Pilot manages books in QuickBooks Online, this axis is a fair question for a bookkeeping product, but no evidence confirms accountant-level CoA control.
